note: Targets at an edge: of their scroll view (cut, a sliver, outside its clip, a sticky header) or of the screen (off it, resting in the status band) — phase 3 B2 (calibration.json: #4, #9, #10, #12, #13, #17, #29). Each target lies in a scroll view (`scrollView`, the clip LabState.scrollViews reports) at a fixed place in its content, scrolled to a fixed offset on appear, so its measured geometry (truth.ts#geometryOf) is what its comment in the app files says. `slot` is only the target's order. App files: AveriLab/Edges.swift, Edges.kt (the layout tables: the same numbers, points on iOS, dp on Android). Android-only variants (round 3, `platforms`): scroll-bounded-flush (scroll-bounded's W, P, S as rows whose identified container is not clickable, so uiautomator cuts its bounds flush with the scroll container's edge: #12, #13) scroll-sticky-cut (scroll-sticky with such a row under a header that is one accessibility element: #9) and scroll-sticky-view (round 4: scroll-sticky-cut with the row's content an Android View, AndroidView, whose bounds Compose does not cut at the header: #9's shape).
